Still possible if 'elsewhere' trips are client meetings, but the variable nature of WFH days and lack of consistent 'office' destination makes this less likely. The Sunday morning activity doesn't strongly support this over the hybrid model.

Discarded. The absence of morning departures on Days 9-10 (Wed-Thu) and the late evening activity on Days 12-13 (Sat-Sun) contradict a rigid 9-5 schedule. The probability is kept minimal as a residual possibility for unusual weekend work, but evidence strongly opposes it.
